sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant moved an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. for lodging first information report against opposite party nos. 2 and 3 on 07.04.2016.
The trial Court registered the case s Misc. Case No. 246 of 2016 on 12.04.2016, and called for report from the concerned Police Station.
the trial Court by means of order dated 24.05.2016, treated the application as complaint case being Complaint Case No. 1824 of 2016.
Subsequently statements under Section 200 Cr.P.C. of the applicant was recorded.
Since then the proceedings of the said case are pending and till date the matter has not been concluded.
It is prayed that in the interest of justice, learned Court below may be directed to conclude the proceedings ofComplaint Case No. 1824 of 2016, expeditiously.
5. Learned Standing Counsel has no objection to the prayer made by the applicant.

6. In view of above, learned trial Court is directed to make every endeavour to conclude and decide the proceedings ofComplaint Case No. 1824 of 2016 - Rajnath Pandey Vs. Rajendra Prasad and Another, under Sections 419, 420 I.P.C., Police Station - Kotwali Akbarpur, District - Ambedkar Nagar, expeditiously, in accordance with law.
